They are not the same number, and the gap IS NOW RECONCILED - see $reconciliation. Do not restore the old explanation that the difference is aliasing: the repo's reconciler disproved it. $reconciliation.$note: Settled 2026-08-31 by the repo's reconciler, re-run 2026-10-18 against DGA stylesheet build CYyqM6kT, cascade- and scope-correct. The kit previously described the gap as 'aliases and per-component role vars resolving to values already carried'. That was WRONG and is retracted.
$reconciliation.$resolutionNote: Values are resolved with LAST-declaration-wins per scope, not first match. DGA redeclares 393 light names - --colors-base-black is #000000 in one :root block and #161616 in a later one - and a first-match resolver reported --background-black as an uncarried #000000 when the effective value is the already-carried #161616. Dark aliases resolve through dark's own redefinitions before falling back to light. That bug inflated the gap by 104 declarations.
$reconciliation.$genericRampNote: 246 are the upstream Untitled-UI ramp DGA ships in CSS but does not publish as a Platforms Code colour. The exclusion list is EXPLICIT, name by name: an earlier 'anything not semantic' rule swept up --colors-border-primary, --colors-text-primary and the --colors-alpha-* primitives as ramp steps, and a wrong exclusion hides a real gap.
$reconciliation.$triageNote: Triage closed 2026-10-18. The 154 open on 2026-08-31 were: DGA's transparency scale (--colors-alpha-alpha-*, --alpha-*), now carried as color.alpha - 42 values, which also covers the --button-*/--link-*/--tag-*/--notification-* roles that alias it; 26 still uncarried under the dark selector, excluded by policy (notCarriedDarkInert); and 9 excluded by name with evidence (notCarriedExcludedByName): three Untitled-UI ramp values one channel step from DGA's own error.900/error.300/warning.800, two bare HSL fragments, and a 70% white the kit carries as role.text.oncolor-tertiary. The per-name list is in https://github.com/mohamedsamy911/dga-kit/blob/master/harvest/RECONCILIATION.md and the EXCLUDED table of https://github.com/mohamedsamy911/dga-kit/blob/master/harvest/reconcile-tokens.py.
$reconciliation.$historicalNote: The figure 1,052 quoted before this reconciliation came from a 2026-08-26 browser getComputedStyle read of :root. The stylesheet parse gives 1,065 declared on :root and 1,126 distinct names overall. Different methods measuring different things; both are recorded rather than one silently replacing the other.
$reconciliation.$compositeNote: 12 declarations are composites - the linear-gradient() set - whose every colour component is already carried. They are NOT missing values: what the kit lacks is the gradient definition (angle and stops), which is a different finding. An earlier cut counted them as confirmed-missing because a composite string can never equal a single carried literal.
$reconciliation.$unresolvedNote: Declarations whose value still contains var() after substitution - a reference to something DGA never declares. Counted separately because an unresolved expression is not evidence that this kit is missing a value. Currently 0: every composite resolves.
$reconciliation.$darkNote: DGA's dark theme is declared under [data-theme=dark] :root, which can never match, and the kit ships no dark CSS. role.dark carries an audit-only subset; the other dark declarations are excluded by policy, counted, not hidden.

$meta.$note: verified=false until a designer signs off. Values are exact. dark.$comment: Dark-theme semantic roles. DGA ships 402 dark declarations; these are the 62 that remap the text and background roles captured above, plus 5 backgrounds dark does NOT remap (carried at their light values, which is what they compute to). The other 340 - link, button, tag, form, featuredicons, border, icon, notification, controls, stepper, table, tooltip - are uncaptured HERE and in the light theme too, by the same scope decision. All 402 are in https://github.com/mohamedsamy911/dga-kit/blob/master/harvest/raw/2026-08-27-dark-theme-roles.json.
dark.$activation: NONE. These values are held for AUDIT ONLY and are deliberately not generated into tokens.css. DGA ships them under [data-theme=dark] :root, which can never match, so upstream the theme is inert - and inert is safe. Correcting the selector would activate 1.05:1 pairings for any consumer already using data-theme="dark" (Chakra v3 does, out of the box). See $verify.

$verify.issue: DGA's own selector can never match. :root is <html>, and a descendant combinator requires :root to HAVE an ancestor carrying [data-theme=dark]. <html> has none. Verified in the live page: querySelectorAll returns 0 with the attribute on <html> and on <body>, and no computed value changes. The bundle contains no prefers-color-scheme rule, no .dark class, and zero instances of the correct :root[data-theme=...] form - so there is no alternative activation path. DGA ships a complete dark theme that cannot turn on.
$verify.action: Retain the values for audit; do NOT emit a corrected selector into any shipped stylesheet. Report the defect to DS-DGA@dga.gov.sa - the fix is theirs to make, and if they make it the theme goes live everywhere at once. Guarded by 'generated CSS ships no live dark rule' in https://github.com/mohamedsamy911/dga-kit/blob/master/evals/validate-fixtures.py. Evidence: https://github.com/mohamedsamy911/dga-kit/blob/master/harvest/raw/2026-08-27-dark-theme-spike.md.

$verify.issue: One of the 12 literal values in the dark block is a WHITE background, where every neighbouring surface resolves to #0c111b-#1f2a37. Checked 2026-10-19 in the live build (index-CYyqM6kT.css, index-BO_6JOKP.js) and on the rendered date picker: the light :root declares the same #ffffff, and no stylesheet, script or shadow style in that build reads var(--form-datecell-background-disabled). The build's date cell dims disabled days with opacity instead (.date-cell--disabled{opacity:0.5}, .date-cell[disabled]{opacity:0.3}); dga-datepicker exposes no property that disables a day, and its demo renders none. No rendered effect was found. Whether DGA intended the value is unknown.
$verify.action: Keep the value as published. Kit advice, from DGA's implementation rather than a stated rule: dim disabled days as DGA's date cell does, and review --dga-form-datecell-background-disabled before using it on a dark surface, where it is white.

$verify.issue: Two hazards. (1) DGA publishes this as -2%, and CSS letter-spacing does not accept percentages - they were proposed in css-text-4 and never shipped, so a browser silently drops the declaration. tokens.json keeps -2% because it is what DGA publishes; generate-tokens.mjs converts it to -0.02em on the way out. (2) Arabic is a connected script - letter-spacing breaks the joins.
$verify.action: Never emit -2% into CSS. The generator converts percentages to em; if you hand-write tracking anywhere, write -0.02em. Scope it to Latin or zero it under [dir="rtl"] - tokens.css ships a guard rule. Do NOT "fix" this value in tokens.json: it is the harvested value and a re-harvest must diff clean.
